summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on improving the functionality of the Mall analytics feature. Key technical requirements identified include:

*   Implementing a master selector for malls, especially if multiple facilities are managed by the company (requiring integration into the design as a combo box).
*   Adding a restriction to the Mall category selection list, which is already loaded on load.
*   Developing a fallback mechanism: If no facilities with the Mall category are found upon loading, a pop-up message should be displayed (e.g., "No malls - no analytics"), offering a redirect back to the root directory via a [Close] button, or simply redirecting initially.
decisions: Implement master selector for multiple facilities/malls
Develop fallback pop-up/redirect if no Malls are found
